Lesson overview:

Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.

Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

language — the words people speak in a country. Example: I can speak two languages.
communication — the act of sharing information. Example: Communication is important at work.
practice — repeated work to improve a skill. Example: I practise every day.
goal — something you want to achieve. Example: My goal is B1.
profile — a short description of a person. Example: This is my language profile.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My languages are ...
• I can speak ...
• I practise every day.
• My goal is ...
• Thank you for listening.

Grammar focus: Can / Can't for language ability.
Present a language profile in three parts: languages, level and goal. Use can and the present simple: I can speak two languages. I practise every day. My goal is B1.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: I can to speak two languages.
